newsitem.title: USA: U.S aviation manufacturers trade group names chief.
newsitem.headline: U.S aviation manufacturers trade group names chief.

text.p: The board of the U.S. General Aviation Manufacturers Association (GAMA) has elected Edward Bolen, its senior vice president, as its new president, the trade group announced on Monday.
It also said the board named outgoing president Edward Stimpson to be vice chairman to focus on special projects, including an effort to increase the number of student pilots.
Bolen said in a statement that GAMA's challenges were the nature of new federal user fees, new regulations for business jets and the future shape of the air transportation system.
"Our ability to respond effectively to those challenges will help determine the future course of general aviation industry," he said.

The association represents makers of general aviation aircraft, engines avionics and related equipment as well as operators of aircraft fleets, base facilities at airports and pilot training facilities.
